
```{r setup}
library(R2jags)
library(corrplot)

trace_file <- "Data/summary/sem_trace.rds"        # MCMC output (all monitored parameters)
theta_file <- "Data/summary/sem_theta.csv"        # posterior mean ability theta per person and task
corr_file  <- "Data/summary/sem_corr.csv"         # posterior mean correlation matrix of the ten tasks

# Task order follows the paper (Task 1-10)
perc_tasks <- c("TPi", "TLetter", "TGabor", "SPi", "SLetter", "SGabor")
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")         # OSPAN, CSPAN, SSPAN, UCMRT
vis_names  <- c("V", "Bwd", "Spa", "Pi", "Letter", "Gabor")  # non-cognitive factors, l = 1..6
all_tasks  <- c(perc_tasks, cog_tasks)
J     <- length(perc_tasks)     # 6
nCog  <- length(cog_tasks)      # 4
nTask <- J + nCog               # 10
L     <- length(vis_names)      # 6 non-cognitive factors; factor L + 1 = cognitive

# posterior mean [95% CI]
ci <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean(x), quantile(x, .025), quantile(x, .975))
# bold the last row of a table (for knitr::kable)
bold_last <- function(tab) {
  n <- nrow(tab); x <- unlist(tab[n, ])
  tab[n, ] <- ifelse(nzchar(x), paste0("**", x, "**"), x)
  tab
}
```

```{r data}
# Process perception data: log transform, then standardize within task
perc_df <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv")
perc_df$correct_num <- ifelse(perc_df$correct == "True", 1, 0)
perc_df$x_raw <- ifelse(perc_df$staircase == 2, perc_df$param1, perc_df$param2)
perc_df <- perc_df[perc_df$x_raw > 0, ]
perc_df$x <- log(perc_df$x_raw)
perc_df$x <- ave(perc_df$x, perc_df$task_name, FUN = function(v) as.numeric(scale(v)))

# Exclude (subject, task) cells flagged as NA in the cleaned scores (4 SD criterion)
clean_scores    <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv")
clean_scores$id <- as.character(clean_scores$id)
excluded_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perc_tasks, function(t) {
  bad_ids <- clean_scores$id[is.na(clean_scores[[t]])]
  if (length(bad_ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(id = bad_ids, task_name = t, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
perc_df$id <- as.character(perc_df$id)
perc_df <- subset(perc_df, !(paste(id, task_name, sep = "_") %in%
                             paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name, sep = "_")))

# Map subject id and task name to indices (task index j = paper's Task number)
ids <- sort(unique(perc_df$id))
perc_df$id_idx   <- match(perc_df$id, ids)
perc_df$task_idx <- match(perc_df$task_name, perc_tasks)
I <- length(ids)

# Aggregate Bernoulli trials -> Binomial counts
agg_df <- aggregate(correct_num ~ id_idx + task_idx + x, data = perc_df,
                    FUN = function(v) c(k = sum(v), n = length(v)))
agg_df <- data.frame(agg_df[, 1:3], y = agg_df$correct_num[, "k"], n = agg_df$correct_num[, "n"])

# Cognitive scores: standardized, higher = better (no sign flip)
cog <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv")
cog$id <- as.character(cog$id)
cog <- reshape(cog, idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide")
names(cog) <- gsub("^score\\.", "", names(cog))
cog[, cog_tasks] <- scale(cog[, cog_tasks])
cog <- unname(as.matrix(cog[match(ids, cog$id), cog_tasks]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cog))
```

```{r model-data}
# Design of the six perception tasks.
#   maskF: masking factor (2 = temporal, 3 = spatial)
#   stim : stimulus (1 = Pi, 2 = Letter, 3 = Gabor); its factor is 3 + stim
# Loadings (standardized scale):
#   general  -> one loading lam_gen shared by all six tasks
#   stimulus -> one loading lamStim[k] shared by the temporal and spatial task of stimulus k
#   masking  -> free loading lamMask[j] for each task
#   cognitive tasks -> free loading lamCog[q] on the cognitive factor
design <- data.frame(task  = perc_tasks,
                     maskF = c(2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3),
                     stim  = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3))
stopifnot(identical(design$task, perc_tasks))

jags_data <- list(
  N = nrow(agg_df), I = I, J = J, nCog = nCog, nTask = nTask, L = L,
  id = agg_df$id_idx, task = agg_df$task_idx, s = agg_df$x,
  y = agg_df$y, nTrial = agg_df$n,
  eps = 1e-6,
  maskF = design$maskF, stim = design$stim,
  isT = as.numeric(design$maskF == 2), isS = as.numeric(design$maskF == 3),
  cog = cog
)
```

```{r run, results = "hide", message = FALSE}
pars <- c("mu", "beta", "sdT",
          "lam_gen", "lamMask", "lamStim", "lamCog", "lamTbar", "lamSbar",
          "Lambda", "delta2", "bfree", "b", "r", "rho",
          "share_gen", "share_mask", "share_stim", "share_uni",
          "Sigma", "theta",
          "zeta")                                   # zeta (= eta_1..eta_L, and residual of eta_{L+1}) is needed for CMDE

# 2 chains x 40,000 post-burn-in iterations, thinned by 10 -> 8,000 posterior draws
fit <- jags(data = jags_data, parameters.to.save = pars,
            model.file = "sem.jags",
            n.chains = 2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 10000, n.thin = 10)
sl <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.list

# ---- save: trace, individual abilities, correlation matrix -------------------
saveRDS(fit, trace_file)
theta_mean <- apply(sl$theta, c(2, 3), mean)       # persons x tasks (larger = better)
dimnames(theta_mean) <- list(ids, perc_tasks)
excl <- paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name)   # excluded cells were imputed: set to NA
for (t in perc_tasks) theta_mean[paste(ids, t) %in% excl, t] <- NA
write.csv(data.frame(id = ids, theta_mean, check.names = FALSE), theta_file, row.names = FALSE)

R_mean <- apply(sl$Sigma, 1, cov2cor)              # posterior mean of the correlation matrix
R_mean <- matrix(rowMeans(R_mean), nTask, dimnames = list(all_tasks, all_tasks))
write.csv(round(R_mean, 4), corr_file)

summ <- fit$BUGSoutput$summary
key  <- grepl("^(mu|beta|sdT|lamMask|lamStim|lamCog|bfree|delta2|share_uni)\\[", rownames(summ)) |
        rownames(summ) %in% c("lam_gen", "lamTbar", "lamSbar")
if (max(summ[key, "Rhat"]) > 1.05)
  warning(sprintf("Max Rhat = %.3f (> 1.05): run longer chains", max(summ[key, "Rhat"])))
```

```{r table1}
fit <- readRDS('Data/summary/sem_trace.rds')
sl <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.list
# Table 1: proportion of variance of each perception task due to each source.
# Loadings are standardized, so the shares are the model parameters themselves:
# the general share is the same for all six tasks, and the stimulus share is the
# same for the temporal and spatial task of each stimulus.
shV <- sl$share_gen
shM <- sl$share_mask
shS <- sl$share_stim
shU <- sl$share_uni

tab_shares <- data.frame(
  Task     = c(perc_tasks, "Average"),
  General  = c(apply(shV, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shV))),
  Masking  = c(apply(shM, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shM))),
  Stimulus = c(apply(shS, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shS))),
  Unique   = c(apply(shU, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shU)))
)
knitr::kable(bold_last(tab_shares), row.names = FALSE, align = "lcccc",
             caption = "Table 1. Variance decomposition of the perception tasks")
```

```{r table2}
# Table 2: relation of the perceptual factors to cognitive performance.
#
# Savage-Dickey BF10 with the posterior density at 0 estimated by CMDE (Morey et al., 2011).
# Free weights bfree = (b_1, b_2, b_4, b_5) ~ N(0, I); b_3, b_6 follow from (C1), (C2): b = A bfree.
# Conditional on the latent factors, zeta_{i,L+1}, and the loadings / cognitive-task parameters:
#   cog_iq ~ N(mu_q + lambda_q (bfree' Xt_i + zeta_i,L+1), delta2_q),  Xt = X A,  X_i = (eta_i1..eta_iL)
#   bfree | rest ~ N(V Xt' s, V),  V = (I / prior_sd^2 + tau Xt'Xt)^-1
#   s_i = sum_q lambda_q r_iq / d2_q,  r_iq = cog_iq - mu_q - lambda_q zeta_i,L+1,  tau = sum_q lambda_q^2 / d2_q
# Tests:  general  H0: b_1 = 0s
#         masking  H0: b_2 = 0            (equivalently b_2 = b_3 = 0)
#         stimulus H0: (b_4, b_5) = 0     (equivalently b_4 = b_5 = b_6 = 0), joint 2-df test
cmde_bf10 <- function(sl, cog, prior_sd = 1) {
  zeta <- sl$zeta                                   # draws x I x (L + 1)
  M    <- dim(zeta)[1]
  K    <- ncol(sl$bfree)                            # 4 free weights
  cidx <- (J + 1):nTask                             # cognitive tasks
  d0   <- matrix(NA_real_, M, 3)                    # posterior density at 0: b_1, b_2, (b_4, b_5)
  for (m in 1:M) {
    A <- matrix(0, L, K)                            # b = A %*% bfree
    A[1, 1]   <- 1
    A[2, 2]   <- 1
    A[3, 2]   <- -sl$lamTbar[m] / sl$lamSbar[m]                 # (C2)
    A[4, 3]   <- 1
    A[5, 4]   <- 1
    A[6, 3:4] <- -sl$lamStim[m, 1:2] / sl$lamStim[m, 3]         # (C1)
    X    <- zeta[m, , 1:L] %*% A                    # I x K   (eta_il = zeta_il for l <= L)
    lam  <- sl$Lambda[m, cidx, L + 1]
    d2   <- sl$delta2[m, cidx]
    R    <- sweep(cog, 2, sl$mu[m, cidx]) - outer(zeta[m, , L + 1], lam)
    s    <- as.numeric(R %*% (lam / d2))
    tau  <- sum(lam^2 / d2)
    V    <- solve(diag(K) / prior_sd^2 + tau * crossprod(X))
    mb   <- as.numeric(V %*% crossprod(X, s))
    Vs   <- V[3:4, 3:4]; ms <- mb[3:4]
    d0[m, ] <- c(dnorm(0, mb[1], sqrt(V[1, 1])),
                 dnorm(0, mb[2], sqrt(V[2, 2])),
                 exp(-0.5 * sum(ms * solve(Vs, ms))) / (2 * pi * sqrt(det(Vs))))
  }
  prior0 <- c(dnorm(0, 0, prior_sd), dnorm(0, 0, prior_sd), 1 / (2 * pi * prior_sd^2))
  setNames(prior0 / colMeans(d0), c("General", "Masking", "Stimulus"))
}
bf10   <- cmde_bf10(sl, cog)
saveRDS(bf10, "Data/summary/sem_bf10.rds")
fmt_bf <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")

# (a) correlation of each factor with the cognitive factor, and BF10
r_post <- sl$r
tab_r <- data.frame(
  Factor = c("General visual", "Temporal masking", "Spatial masking", "Pi", "Letter", "Gabor"),
  r      = apply(r_post, 2, ci),
  H0     = c("b1 = 0", "b2 = b3 = 0", "", "b4 = b5 = b6 = 0", "", ""),
  BF10   = c(fmt_bf(bf10["General"]), fmt_bf(bf10["Masking"]), "", fmt_bf(bf10["Stimulus"]), "", "")
)
knitr::kable(tab_r, row.names = FALSE, align = "lccc",
             caption = "Table 2. Correlation of each perceptual factor with the cognitive factor")
```
